```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

generate_protein_correlation_summary <- function(
    repo_local_dir,
    selected_tissue = "blood",
    selected_ome = "prot-ol",
    group_code = "ADUEndur",
    timepoint = "during_40_min",
    outcome_var = "egfr_labr",
    output_prefix = "Protein_EGFR_Correlation",
    figure_dir,
    file_dir, 
    output_format = "pdf",
    gsutil_cmd = "gsutil"
) {
  
  required_libs <- c(
    "dplyr", "ggplot2", "tidyverse", "glue",
    "MotrpacHumanPreSuspension", "MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData",
    "openxlsx"
  )
  missing_libs <- required_libs[!sapply(required_libs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(missing_libs) > 0) {
    stop(paste0("Missing packages: ", paste(missing_libs, collapse = ", "),
                ". Please install them first."))
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(lapply(required_libs, library, character.only = TRUE))
  
  valid_omes <- c("prot-ol", "metab", "transcript-rna-seq")
  valid_groups <- c("ADUEndur", "ADUResist", "ADUControl")
  
  if (!(selected_ome %in% valid_omes)) {
    message(glue::glue("⚠️ Skipping: '{selected_ome}' is not a valid omics type. Must be one of {toString(valid_omes)}."))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  if (!(group_code %in% valid_groups)) {
    message(glue::glue("⚠️ Skipping: '{group_code}' is not a valid group. Must be one of {toString(valid_groups)}."))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  

  
  if (!dir.exists(figure_dir)) {
    dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Plot output directory: {figure_dir}"))
  }
  
  if (!dir.exists(file_dir)) {
    dir.create(file_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    message(glue::glue("📂 Created Files output directory: {file_dir}"))
  }
  
  # ----------------------------- #
  # 3️⃣ Load differential analysis
  # ----------------------------- #
  differential_analysis <- load_differential_analysis(
    repo_local_dir = repo_local_dir,
    selected_omes = selected_ome,
    selected_tissues = selected_tissue,
    single_matrix = TRUE,
    combine_with_featgene = TRUE,
    epigen = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(contrast_type == "exercise_with_controls")
  
  da_filtered <- differential_analysis %>%
    dplyr::filter(randomGroupCode == group_code, Timepoint == timepoint)
  
  # ----------------------------- #
  # 4️⃣ Load QC-normalized omics data
  # ----------------------------- #
  omes_data <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::load_qc(
    selected_tissues = selected_tissue,
    selected_omes = selected_ome,
    epigen = FALSE,
    gsutil = gsutil_cmd,
    repo_local_dir = NULL,
    load_acute_only = TRUE,
    remove_unnamed_metab = TRUE,
    remove_redundant_metab = TRUE,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  sample_metadata <- omes_data[[selected_tissue]][[selected_ome]][["sample_metadata"]]
  feature_metadata <- omes_data[[selected_tissue]][[selected_ome]][["feature_metadata"]]
  qc_norm <- omes_data[[selected_tissue]][[selected_ome]][["qc_norm"]]
  
  df_qc_norm <- as.data.frame(t(qc_norm))
  df_qc_norm$vialLabel <- row.names(df_qc_norm)
  df_qc_norm <- df_qc_norm[, c("vialLabel", setdiff(names(df_qc_norm), "vialLabel"))]
  
  df_sample <- merge(sample_metadata, df_qc_norm, by = "vialLabel")
  df_sample <- df_sample[df_sample$Timepoint == "pre_exercise",]
  
  # ----------------------------- #
  # 5️⃣ Merge with clinical data
  # ----------------------------- #
  lab_data <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::cln_raw_local_lab_results[["data"]] %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, visit_code, all_of(outcome_var)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(visit_code == "ADU_SCP")
  
  df_merged <- merge(lab_data, df_sample, by = "pid")
  
  # ----------------------------- #
  # 6️⃣ Mapping for protein IDs
  # ----------------------------- #
  mapping <- MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData::HUMAN_FEATURE_TO_GENE %>%
    filter(assay == selected_ome) %>%
    dplyr::select(feature_id, uniprot, gene_symbol)
  
  protein_list <- mapping$feature_id
  
  # ----------------------------- #
  # 7️⃣ Correlation Calculation
  # ----------------------------- #
  calculate_protein_correlation_individual <- function(df, protein_list, outcome, mapping_df = NULL) {
    protein_list <- intersect(protein_list, colnames(df))
    cor_values <- sapply(protein_list, function(prot) {
      cor(df[[prot]], df[[outcome]], use = "complete.obs")
    })
    p_values <- sapply(protein_list, function(prot) {
      temp <- df[, c(outcome, prot)]
      temp <- temp[complete.cases(temp), ]
      if (nrow(temp) < 3) return(NA)
      cor.test(temp[[prot]], temp[[outcome]], method = "pearson")$p.value
    })
    n_obs <- sapply(protein_list, function(prot) {
      sum(complete.cases(df[, c(prot, outcome)]))
    })
    cor_df <- data.frame(feature_id = protein_list,
                         correlation = cor_values,
                         p_value_corr = p_values,
                         n_obs = n_obs,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (!is.null(mapping_df)) {
      cor_df <- merge(mapping_df, cor_df, by = "feature_id")
    }
    cor_df
  }
  
  cor_df_full <- calculate_protein_correlation_individual(df_merged, protein_list, outcome_var, mapping)
  
  cor_df_full_ex <- merge(
    cor_df_full,
    da_filtered[, c("feature_id", "p_value", "adj_p_value")],
    by = "feature_id"
  ) %>% filter(!is.na(correlation))
  
  # ----------------------------- #
  # 8️⃣ Save correlation data
  # ----------------------------- #
  output_csv <- file.path(file_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_correlations.csv"))
  write.csv(cor_df_full, output_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  
  # ----------------------------- #
  # 9️⃣ Plot significant correlations
  # ----------------------------- #
  df_sig <- cor_df_full_ex %>% filter(adj_p_value <= 0.05)
  df_sig$gene_symbol <- as.character(df_sig$gene_symbol)
  if (nrow(df_sig) > 0) {
    df_sig <- df_sig %>%
      mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(gene_symbol), feature_id, gene_symbol)) %>%
      arrange(desc(correlation)) %>%
      mutate(label = factor(label, levels = label))
    df_sig$label <- factor(df_sig$label, levels = df_sig$label)
    
  p <- ggplot(df_sig, aes(x = label, y = correlation, fill = correlation > 0)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "blue", "FALSE" = "red")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title = "",
           x = "Protein Assay", y = "Correlation") +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                   size = 4, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
      )
    output_plot <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(output_prefix, "_barplot.", output_format))
    ggsave(output_plot, plot = p, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
    }else {
      message("⚠️ No significant correlations found.")}

  
  message(glue::glue("✅ Saved correlation table: {output_csv}"))
  message(glue::glue("✅ Saved correlation plot: {figure_dir}"))
  
  invisible(list(correlation_data = cor_df_full_ex,
                 correlation_file = output_csv,
                 plot_file = output_plot))
}

```
